verdicts.reason: A keeps the original top-to-bottom order (logo, can, headline, body, badges, CTA), so it still reads as the same design. Its flaws: the three badges zigzag left/center/right instead of stacking in a clean column, the Sunset Sale ribbon is crowded against the logo, and the red missing-asset placeholder sits big and close to the legal text at the bottom. B wrecks the hierarchy: the headline takes up the whole top third, the CTA sits above the product, and the can and logo shrink to tiny afterthoughts. The Sunset Sale ribbon is wedged between the badges, the badges are scattered, and the placeholder is jammed into the bottom-left corner.
